name: Gao-Qi Rao
evidence: Identity and org CONFIRMED (Gaoqi Rao, Chinese 饶高琦, Beijing Language and Culture University): Semantic Scholar author 2274010379 shows the expected BLCU corpus/NLP record (co-authors Endong Xun, Meng-Xi Guo, Lung-Hao Lee; 'NLP for Chinese L2 Writing: Chinese Grammatical Error Diagnosis', Chinese register/stylistics and international-Chinese-education papers), and search snippets confirm the Google Scholar profile 'gaoqi rao' (user=4Sughk8AAAAJ) with interests NLP / Linguistics / Digital Humanities, 'verified email at blcu.edu.cn', Research Institute of International Chinese Language Education, BLCU, plus committee-chair listings for CCL 2022 and CCL 2024 under Beijing Language and Culture University. However: no ResearchGate profile surfaced for 'Gaoqi Rao' / 'Gao-Qi Rao' (site:researchgate.net/profile search returned only Scholar/Springer/CCL pages and unrelated RG publication pages), and site:linkedin.com/in 'Gaoqi Rao' + BLCU returned no profile (only Yufeng Gao at BLCU and other unrelated Gao namesakes - rejected). Email: Google Scholar only states the blcu.edu.cn domain, never the address itself, which is not a printed address; the MDPI source paper (doi 10.3390/bdcc10090290) and the BLCU faculty directory are blocked by this environment's egress proxy; no arXiv record for this name. No templated address guessed. | Semantic Scholar checked (paper 22d48975..., DOI 10.3390/bdcc10090290): author list confirmed, but S2 Graph API exposes no email field and returned empty affiliations/homepage for all five authors; openAccessPdf resolves to doi.org, and doi.org/mdpi.com are blocked by the environment's network policy, so the MDPI affiliation block (which would print the addresses) is unreachable from this session. S2 externalIds give DBLP alias 'Gaoqi Rao'.
